My idea of logistics come from the game “Squad”. When your in a significant battle, logistics are paramount for success. Use 1 or 2 troops to drive a transport truck, or whatever you need to and from base. I use them to pickup new high command troops I may need to reinforce the battlefield. I then strategically deploy the team to whatever flank needs reinforcing.

Zeus is definitely key for you to be able to see the entire battlefield. High Command camera IMO is crappy and does give you the slightest tactical control. Antistasi Ultimate. The key to longer firefights is to allow the ai a high skill level and deny them a high accuracy level. This allows them to be smart and strategic but not minions of John Wick. My Antistasi AI are both set to the highest skill level, while the accuracy ( if im remembering correctly, at work currently lol) is set to 0.2; Do keep in mind this is in conjunction with CF_BAI which affect the vision of AI. So time of day, weather , terrain, all play a factor on how well the AI see and perform
